_comment: Model -> USD price per 1,000,000 tokens. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for subagent cost derivation (T-PATCH-202). Read by BOTH packages/gui/electron/ipc/costArchive.ts (JS, inlined at vite build) and packages/core/scripts/productune (python, read at runtime). Subagent turns.jsonl rows record usage+model only; cost_usd is DERIVED here at aggregation time so the price table never duplicates.
_source: claude-api skill (shared/models.md + SKILL.md current-models table), cached 2026-06-04. Update when Anthropic changes pricing; re-check via the claude-api skill, not memory.
_pricing_model: cost_usd = (input_tokens + 0.1*cache_read_input_tokens + 1.25*cache_creation_input_tokens) * in_per_mtok/1e6 + output_tokens * out_per_mtok/1e6. Prompt-caching multipliers (T-PATCH-202, per claude-api skill): cache reads bill at ~0.1x the base input rate; cache writes (creation) at 1.25x for the 5-minute TTL. turns.jsonl does not distinguish 5-minute vs 1-hour cache writes, so creation is priced at the 5-minute 1.25x (the common/default case). An untagged 'cache' field is treated as a cache read (dominant, cheaper tier). Still a client-side estimate. Implemented identically in costArchive.ts (deriveCostUsd) and the python derive_cost.
